description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Issue an e-tax invoice to 국세청. IRREVERSIBLE: once issued the buyer is notified and it enters VAT filing; it can only be corrected by issuing a 수정세금계산서. Call without confirm first — you get a preview of exactly what will be issued; show it to the user, get their approval, then retry with confirm=true. Never set confirm=true on your own.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and receiving their explicit approval. Omit it on the first call to obtain the preview.

dmnr_bsno.description: Buyer business registration number (구매자 사업자등록번호, 10 digits)

etxiv_clsf_cd.description: Invoice class code (세금계산서 종류 코드). Optional.

etxiv_knd_cd.description: Invoice kind code (세금계산서 유형 코드). Optional.

name: hometax__etax__invoice__issue
title: 전자세금계산서 발행
